topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: The forest feels vast, but when you find a familiar shape, it shrinks to the warmth of a den. I've watched you, known your steps, your quiet presence. When you told me, the air seemed to hold its breath. Moving, you said, a long way, where the trees will be different, the scents unfamiliar. I will stay here, where the ground is known, where every shadow tells a story we both understand. But I will carry the memory of your closeness, the silent hours we shared, the way we moved as one through the undergrowth. You’ll take a piece of this forest with you, the part that whispers of our path together. And though the distance will stretch, remember, the bond we forged is as unbreakable as the roots that bind the earth.
